title: Promising Practices for Equitable Remote Learning: Emerging lessons from COVID-19 education responses in 127 countries
abstract: This brief reviews education responses to COVID-19 school closures across 127 countries, focusing on whether remote-learning opportunities reached children equitably. It synthesizes country-reported approaches and lessons about the reach and limitations of technology-dependent delivery, particularly where access to devices, connectivity, or other resources is uneven. The review points toward combining digital and non-digital learning options and designing responses around the needs of children who are most likely to be left out.
